title: Donkey Kong Bananza
description: Donkey Kong and Pauline smash, tunnel, and punch through a vast underground world using destructive strength and vocal powers.

title: Pokemon Pokopia
description: Players become a Ditto rebuilding a desolate world with Pokemon companions, blending Minecraft-style building with Animal Crossing-like life sim.

title: Mario Kart World
description: Open-world reimagining of Mario Kart letting players race freely across an interconnected world with platforming elements like jumping and wall riding.

title: Yoshi and the Mysterious Book
description: Yoshi explores a magical storybook world emphasizing creature-interaction puzzles and experimentation over traditional platforming.

title: FAST Fusion
description: Spiritual successor to F-Zero featuring hypersonic antigravity racing at 60fps with fusion-based vehicle customization.

title: Hyrule Warriors: Age of Imprisonment
description: Musou-style action spinoff expanding on Tears of the Kingdom's Imprisoning War, with hordes of enemies and canon side stories.

title: Kirby Air Riders
description: Sakurai-directed revival of Kirby Air Ride with racing, City Trial, and Top Ride modes built on deep physics-driven controls.

title: Mario Tennis Fever
description: Mario tennis title with 38 characters and 30 Fever Rackets, emphasizing chaotic multiplayer fun over its tutorial-like solo campaign.

title: Survival Kids
description: Cooperative four-player survival game where stranded kids navigate an island through teamwork and puzzle-solving.

title: Drag x Drive
description: 3v3 wheelchair basketball game using dual Joy-Con 2 motion controls to steer and shoot, showcasing Switch 2's mouse-style controls.
